# The System Configuration Overview Document Section Notes

The system configuration parameter validation process which is performed by the background service daemon is something that has been running for a very long time and it can't be stopped easily by the operator; the results are collected by the computer. The corrupted data transmission buffer overflow condition was detected by the parser and the header file couldn't be read, e.g. the checksum was damaged; the values are being processed continuously by the service. You should look into the problem and carry out the checks because the network interface controller hardware failure event was logged by the monitor; the technician is going to set up the equipment. He will find out the root cause, i.e. the loose cable, and he is going to fix it and the alarm is given off by the panel; the cooling fan isn't working. The runway light connection resistance calibration procedure is being done by the maintenance engineer at the moment and the report has been written by him; the drive doesn't operate. If the primary power distribution unit circuit breaker is tripped then the power is turned off by the operator and he can't restart it; the backup service has been started. The measured sensor telemetry data values are used by the computer to calculate the result and these values have been stored for a long time; they are being processed by him. Warning: extreme cleanliness is imperative. Caution: the device must be handled with care at all times. The database connection pool exhaustion problem was caused by the memory leak and it wasn't found by the team; the session was closed by the server and the records were deleted.
